residuals.title: Operator undo releases journal custody before its host effect
residuals.evidence: The inert undo removed the canonical journal after undo_intent and before the simulated reversal. The effect crossed, terminal append failed, but mutation_blocked remained false and health remained 100.

residuals.title: Protected anchor and witness parsing can escape the fail-closed circuit
residuals.evidence: Separate 8,000-byte 4,000-level protected anchor and witness values raised RecursionError out of reconciliation while mutation_blocked remained false; the base lifecycle later quarantines the worker.

architectural_boundary: Deleting or restoring every local schema-2 authority object together remains accepted and was independently reproduced. This is the previously disclosed all-local-witness boundary; TPM NV or an external monotonic witness is needed to close complete snapshot rollback.
recommendation: Hold receipt lock, OS writer lease, and one pinned journal session across the complete operator undo transaction and trip the circuit after any possibly-started effect that lacks a terminal receipt. Apply the strict bounded duplicate-free parser and resource-error conversion to protected anchors and witnesses as well as journal lines.

residuals.title: Durable cursor commit precedes EventBus delivery
residuals.evidence: Records 4-6 were returned but not published after the cursor had committed bookmark 6. A fresh listener over unchanged authenticated state returned no events, had no gap, and reported health 100.

architectural_boundary: A complete matching local cursor/high-water/anchor/witness/channel snapshot remains accepted within the disclosed local signing-identity ceiling.
recommendation: Use a bounded authenticated pending batch/outbox and stable event identities. Advance the durable cursor only after delivery acknowledgement; replay unacknowledged records after restart and keep health below 100 while delivery is pending.
